text:
Rina (SE): opening POC for Helios Retail — requirements: streaming chat + server-initiated tool calls to inventory service, strict JSON schema (fail-fast), and Go + Rust SDK examples. Questions: ephemeral creds pattern, token rotation cadence, hosted vs reserved cost comparison.
Carlos (AE): client expects ~200 rps peaks during sale windows, avg ~140 tokens. They want p95 < 250ms. Procurement will ask for EKM language.
Mina (Eng): for 200 rps and 140 tokens we recommend a 1-node Dedicated pool for steady p95; hosted pilot is fine but expect tail variability. Can you confirm hours/day?
Rina (SE): pilot 8h/day for 3 weeks. Also they require tool callbacks to be authenticated and want schema violations emitted to telemetry.
Arjun (Security): callbacks: recommend customer queue (SQS/Kafka). If direct webhooks required: mTLS + IP allowlist + rotating webhook signing tokens (rotate <=12h). KMS: Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Dedicated can include EKM addendum. SOC2 Type II boilerplate available.
Mina (Eng): onboarding runbook (brief): 1) start hosted for quick test, 2) provision 1-node Dedicated if SLO required, 3) enable structured_output_mode with strict_schema=true and action=reject, 4) deploy credential-broker for STS tokens, 5) configure schema_violation webhook to customer telemetry.
Po (DevEx): Go SDK snippet (streaming + toolcall handling):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithTokenProvider(brokerProvider))
stream, _ := client.ChatStream(ctx, "helios-1", opts)
for ev := range stream.Events() { if ev.Type=="toolcall" { go handleTool(ev.Payload) } else { fmt.Print(ev.Delta.Text) } }
```
Mina (Eng): Rust snippet (compact):
```rust
let client = Client::with_token_provider(MyProvider::new());
let mut s = client.chat_stream("helios-1", msgs).await?;
while let Some(ev) = s.next().await { match ev { Event::ToolCall(req) => handle_tool(req).await?, Event::Delta(d) => print!("{}", d.text), _ => {} } }
```
Rina (SE): ephemeral token flow? they wont store long-lived creds on internal services.
Arjun (Security): pattern: Redwood STS issues short-lived tokens (TTL=15m). Customer runs a credential-broker (lambda/container) that exchanges a long-lived service principal for STS tokens and returns them to the caller. TokenProvider refreshes when TTL < 60s. We'll share sample broker.
Carlos (AE): pricing: need two scenarios for customer deck by EOD — hosted per-token estimate for 8h/day pilot and a reserved 1-node monthly commitment (pro-rated ok). Also show delta for streaming vs non-streaming.
Mina (Eng): quick back-of-envelope: tokens = rps * tokens * seconds/day * days. For 200 rps, 140 tokens, 8h/day, 21 days -> ~5.06B tokens. Hosted = $X per 1M tokens; reserved = fixed monthly + lower unit cost. I'll draft two scenarios and a short bullet summary.
Arjun (Security): blockers: legal wants EKM wording and SOC2 evidence; callback hardening checklist is required. I'll draft questionnaire answers and webhook hardening text.
Rina (SE): next steps: 1) Carlos confirm pilot hours (done), 2) Mina to drop runbook + two price scenarios + Dedicated checklist, 3) Arjun to provide SOC2/KMS language and webhook guidance, 4) Po to share credential-broker sample. Schedule 30m tech kickoff for Tue 10am PT.
Mina (Eng): will post quote scenarios and runbook in ~3 hours.
Arjun (Security): will post security responses in ~2 hours.
Po (DevEx): sharing sample STS broker link shortly.
Carlos (AE): thanks all :thumbsup: tagging @Mina @Arjun @Po for deliverables.
